description: M-FINAL MF-DEC reference campaign (workspace/reports/engine-v2/m-final/PLAN.md §2.2): MadLoop quadruple-precision one-loop references of the eight decay rows XX01-XX08 (1 -> 2 and 1 -> 3, QCD and EW) at exact rest-frame points (decay_points.py), the decaying particle at its real mass with zero own width. Runs live under $LOOP_REFERENCE_ROOT/runs/dec/<run>/ and their merged references are committed as tests/fixtures/loop/required/dec/<run>.json. Driven by mqcd_campaign.py --campaign dec_campaign.json.

evaluation.description: as the M-SM campaign (msm_campaign.json): every point in MadLoop's quadruple-precision stage, its own test at MLStabThres 1e-13 choosing Ninja or CutTools, HelicityFilterLevel = 0. For a decay MadLoop's quadruple-precision point improvement takes its PSMC method (the ORIG method needs two massless beams).
